message: 合い言葉はちゃっ！

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, it's Synn-kun. Cha!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, hello, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wrong! It's 'Cha!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Ch... Cha!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooooh~ Well said! You actually said it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really something to get that excited over?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm trying to spread the compressed greeting 'Cha!' instead of 'Konnichiwa,' you know~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So let's make the theme for the Charity Bazaar 'Cha!' I'm counting on you~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ch-Chaaaaaa~~~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you express your anger using 'Cha,' I have no idea how I'm supposed to respond to that...」

name: Yumil
message: 「Huh? If it isn't Sakura-senpai」
Okamoto-san walked over from the serving counter.
On her tray were two servings of curry rice, along with glass tumblers brimful of cold water with spoons stuck inside them.

name: Yumil
message: 「By any chance, did you have plans to get tea with Sacchin-senpai? If you want to order anything, I'll bring it right over for you」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I came here to scout out Prier on behalf of the Student Council」

name: Synn
message: 「I need to check the number of tables and chairs, as well as where the power outlets are, to prepare for the bazaar」

name: Synn
message: 「We have data sheets on this stuff in the Student Council room, but sometimes things are different in person」

name: Yumil
message: 「Is that right? Thanks for all your hard work as president」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yumil~ I couldn't possibly invite Synn-kun out behind Nana-chan's back~」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「*Sigh*... Nana-chan sure has her work cut out for her~」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, well, hoho~~ While Nana-chan is away at the Student Council, the Sweets Club is my kingdom!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And so--」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir.」
Okamoto-san sets Prier's special curry rice and a mini salad on the table.

name: Synn
message: 「Having a tasting session? You are the vice president of the Sweets Club, after all, Sacchin.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold up, hold up! Curry ain't a sweet, y'know?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Curry has apples and honey and stuff in it, so it's totally fine~」

name: Synn
message: 「That feels like sophistry, though I suppose you have a point.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if you eat curry rice at this hour, won't you be too full for dinner?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「This is snack curry, so it's fine~ I'm a growing girl, you know~」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're awfully tiny for all that, though.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe~ I'm just a late bloomer~」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's also the phrase 'unfinished talent,' y'know. Even with all your constant snacking, you're still flat where it counts--none of it's sticking.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Simply being young burns energy all on its own~」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sacchin, you really sound strangely philosophical sometimes.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahem! Now then, let's begin today's meeting~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Regarding 'Whether or not the raisins sitting on top of curry rice count as sweets'~」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-So stupid. That ain't a topic for someone who's supposed to be all philosophical.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sacchin, isn't it kind of like pineapple in sweet-and-sour pork? That stuff is there to tenderize the meat.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Boss, there ain't even a trace of these curry raisins ever makin' contact with the roux~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What a revelation...!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Why are you shocked?」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yes, I'd like to share my opinion too. As long as it tastes good, doesn't anything go?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooooh~ Well said! You actually said it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Meeting adjou~rned.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So fast?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The verdict is in! In that case... time to dig in!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir. Let's eat, ssu」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, we could never have a tasting session like this if Nanaka were around」
Giving a quick nod to Sacchin and Okamoto-san, who have entered full eating mode, I step away from the table
And then, a recheck of Prier
...Yeah! It's perfect. Not a single mistake in the data Misa organized!
